notes: Reached entirely through the Claude-in-Chrome tab (own tab, closed at the end); no proxy/HTTP client used. robots.txt names no Claude agent (only generic Demandware/search/cart/account disallows) and publishes sitemap_index.xml. Tree taken from three independent sources and unioned, per the mandatory cross-check: (a) sitemap_3-category.xml pulled by same-origin fetch from the loaded page (1564 category URLs, 164 under /c/maison); (b) the rendered mega-menu, whose full Maison branch is present in the DOM as data-levels attributes (139 Maison nodes); (c) each category page's own sub-category tile strip. The sitemap UNDER-reports: it lists only 3 children of Mobilier, while the Mobilier page tile strip and the mega-menu both show 5 - 'Poufs, tabourets, chaises' and 'Tables basses' exist only in (b) and (c). Mega-menu and tile strip agree on exactly those 5, so the union is complete. Furniture at Monoprix lives in exactly one department, Maison > Mobilier (h1 MOBILIER, 47 resultats), recorded as a grouping row with its 5 children as leaves. Counts are client-rendered (not present in the raw HTML, no __NEXT_DATA__/__NUXT__ and no count field in the served markup), so every qty is the rendered listing header 'N resultats' read from the live DOM after navigation; each leaf's h1 and rel=canonical were checked to match the slug requested (bad-slug/parent-substitution trap). The five counts are all different from each other and from the 47 parent total, so no site-wide constant is being echoed; no rounding, no sums (23+14+3+8+7=55 > 47 because the same SKUs are filed in several Mobilier children - children were NOT summed and the parent total was NOT reused). EXCLUDED as duplicates: https://www.monoprix.fr/c/maison/exterieur/mobilier-et-decoration-dexterieur (and its /c/loisirs/exterieur/ twin) is a second path onto the identical 3-product set already recorded as Outdoor Furniture - same three product titles, same count - so only the node under the Mobilier department is emitted. EXCLUDED as a mixed decor node with no unique furniture: https://www.monoprix.fr/c/maison/decoration/decoration-mobilier-enfant/mobilier-enfant is a genuinely distinct node (own canonical, also labelled 'Mobilier enfant', also 7 resultats) but sits under the Decoration department and its 7 products are 5 kids furniture items plus 2 rugs; every furniture item in it already appears in Mobilier > Mobilier enfant, so recording it would add textiles and no new furniture. EXCLUDED branches, inspected and dismissed: Maison > Chambre is bedding/bed linen only (linge de lit, literie, couettes, oreillers, protege-matelas - no beds or bed frames anywhere on the site); Maison > Salle de bain is bath linen plus soap dishes, toothbrush holders and mirrors, no vanity units; Maison > Decoration is decor, candles, wall decor, lamps, cushions, rugs, baskets; Maison > Arts de la table et Cuisine is tableware/cookware; Buanderie et Menage, Petit electromenager, Chat et Chien, Exterieur > Plage/Jardinage are out of scope; the Mode/Beaute/Loisirs/Bebe/Enfant departments carry no furniture nodes (bebe and enfant are stubs with no children in the category sitemap). No sofas, beds, wardrobes, desks or dining tables exist in this catalogue - Monoprix Maison carries a small furniture line of stools, chairs, small tables and light storage units, which is consistent with a supermarket home department.
